Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 2026

1. Introduction

This Privacy Policy describes how RIMONSTAR Game Studio ("we", "us", or "our") handles information related to visitors of this website. We are committed to being transparent about what data we collect and how we use it.

2. Information We Collect

This website is static and does not use a backend database, user accounts, or tracking cookies. We do not collect personal information unless you voluntarily contact us via email.

If you contact us by email, we will receive the email address and content you provide. We use this information solely to respond to your inquiry and do not store it beyond what is necessary.

3. Cookies and Analytics

This website does not use cookies for tracking or advertising purposes. If analytics are added in the future, this section will be updated to reflect what is collected and how to opt out.

4. Third-Party Services

This website may link to third-party services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those services. We encourage you to review their privacy policies independently.

5. Game-Specific Privacy

[PLACEHOLDER] — When specific games are released, this section must be updated with game-specific privacy information, including any data collected by the game (e.g., save data, preferences, analytics), how it is stored, and how users can request deletion.

6. Your Rights

You may contact us at any time to request information about or deletion of any personal data you have shared with us via email. We will respond promptly.

7. Children's Privacy

This website is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

9. Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at contact@YOURDOMAIN.com.
